page.overview:
What is You're Sixteen?

You’re Sixteen was a No. 1 hit single by Beatles member Ringo Starr, originally written by the Sherman Brothers (Robert B. Sherman and Richard M. Sherman). It is also one of his most popular songs. The song is about a about a girl the singer falls love in. The song was first performed by Johnny Burnette, an rockabilly singer from America, whose version which peaked at number eight at the Billboard Hot 100 charts.
